title: Single SQLite connection shared across ThreadingHTTPServer threads without a lock
evidence: app.py:14 sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False) is shared by make_handler; app.py:6,129 ThreadingHTTPServer runs handlers concurrently, and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE commits (app.py:89-92,108-116) have no mutex, so concurrent writes can interleave cursors/commits
suggestion: Guard writes with a threading.Lock, or open a connection per request/thread

title: PUT requires a full valid body (no partial update)
evidence: app.py:104-110 PUT reuses validate(), which requires non-empty title+author; a partial PUT is rejected 400. Matches spec ('Update a book') and README ('Full update'), noted for cross-run comparison only
suggestion: None required; optionally support PATCH-style partial updates
